S2:
METHOD per class — PDF_COMPATIBLE: PyMuPDF (pymupdf 1.28.0) enumerates every page's font resources through the PDF structures themselves (xref, subtype, base font name, encoding), compressed object streams included; embedding is read from the font descriptor's FontFile/FontFile2/FontFile3 key; the same bytes are also scanned as text for DSC/PostScript font declarations and recorded separately. POSTSCRIPT / EPS binary-header: DSC comments (%%DocumentFonts, %%DocumentNeededResources font …, %%IncludeResource) plus /FontName and /BaseFont declarations, read as text.
LIMITS stated: a viewer's font list names the faces the PDF layer declares; text converted to outlines names no font and is invisible here; Illustrator's private data stream (the editable layer) is not parsed as such, so a face used only in the private layer with the PDF layer flattened would not appear; PostScript DSC lists are what the producing application wrote. Nothing is guessed — a file without declarations is reported as referencing no font.
